title: NBA star Brandon Clarke died from heroin, cocaine effects, examiner rules
english: NBA player Brandon Clarke passed away at the age of 29 due to the accidental combined effects of heroin, cocaine, and various prescription medications. He was discovered unresponsive in a California residence back in May. The Memphis Grizzlies forward, who had faced recent legal issues and injury struggles, was remembered by his team as a highly respected athlete and community member.
amharic: የኤንቢኤ ቅርጫት ኳስ ተጫዋች ብራንደን ክላርክ በሄሮይን፣ በኮኬይን እና በተወሰኑ የሐኪም ማዘዣ መድኃኒቶች ድብልቅ ውጤት በ29 ዓመቱ በድንገት ሕይወቱ አልፏል። ተጫዋቹ ባለፈው ግንቦት ወር በካሊፎርኒያ በሚገኝ መኖሪያ ቤት ውስጥ ህይወት አልባ ሆኖ ተገኝቷል። የሜምፊስ ግሪዝሊስ ቡድኑ፣ በቅርብ ጊዜ በህግ እና በጉዳት ችግሮች ውስጥ የነበረውን ተጫዋች እንደ ታላቅ አትሌት እና ማህበረሰብ ተቆርቋሪ ሰው በማለት አስታውሶታል።
oromo: Taphataan kubbaa miilaa NBA Brandon Clarke yeroo inni umuriin isaa waggaa 29tti, sababa dhiibbaa ሄሮይን (heroin), ኮኬይን (cocaine) fi qorichoota fayyaa walitti makamaniin tasa du’e. Taphataan kun ji’a darbe keessa bakka inni California jiraatu keessatti osoo lubbuun hin jiru argame. Gareen isaa Memphis Grizzlies, taphataa yeroo dhihoo as rakkoo seeraa fi miidhaa qaamaa keessa ture kana, akka nama baay'ee kabajamee fi nama hawaasaaf yaaduutti yaadatu.

title: Iran parliament speaker hails journalists as 'frontline commanders in media battle'
english: Iran's parliament speaker, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, honored journalists by calling them essential commanders in an ongoing media conflict. He praised them for using their reporting skills to protect the public from misinformation and enemy narratives. By emphasizing the truth, he believes journalists play a vital role in preventing the spread of deceptive propaganda.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ ጋዜጠኞችን በዘመናዊው የመገናኛ ብዙኃን ትግል ግንባር ቀደም መሪዎች ሲሉ አሞካሽተዋል። ጋዜጠኞች በብዕር እና በምስል በመታገዝ ህዝብን ከጠላት የተሳሳተ ፕሮፓጋንዳ እንደሚከላከሉ ገልጸዋል። እውነታውን በማሳወቅ ህዝቡ ከሀሰተኛ መረጃ እንዲጠበቅ በማድረግ ረገድ ያላቸውን ሚና አጉልተው አሳይተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iran, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, gaazexeessitootni waraana miidiyaa keessatti ajajoota duraa akka ta'an ibsaniiru. Gaazexeessitootni dhugaa baasuufi odeeffannoo sirrii ta'e fayyadamanii, hawaasni odeeffannoo sobaa fi yaada diinaa akka hin fudhanne ittisuu akka qaban hubachiisaniiru. Gaheen gaazexeessitootaa kunis, dhugaa ifa baasuun injifannoo sobaa diinonni yaadan fashaleessuuf murteessaa akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Morning recap
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have formed a new joint defense agreement that is open to other nations and has received regional support. Meanwhile, regional tensions remain high, with ongoing military clashes reported in Yemen and the West Bank alongside humanitarian concerns in Gaza. Furthermore, international diplomatic efforts are underway to address maritime stability in the Strait of Hormuz amidst rising fears of an escalating conflict between the United States and Iran.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን ለሌሎች ሀገራት ክፍት የሆነ አዲስ የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ በየመን እና በዌስት ባንክ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት እንዲሁም በጋዛ ያለው የሰብአዊ ቀውስ አሳሳቢ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል። ከዚህም በላይ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ፣ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ ሰላምን ለማስፈን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች እየተደረጉ ይገኛል።
oromo: Turkiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaafi Paakistaan walii galtee ittisa biyyaa kan biyyoota birootiifis banaa ta'e mallatteessaniiru. Yeroo ammaa kana Yemenii fi Qarqara Lixa Yordaanos keessatti walitti bu'iinsiifi rakkoon namoomaa Gaazaa keessa jiru daran hammaachaa jira. Kana malees, walitti bu'iinsa Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduu jiru tasgabbeessuuf fi nagaa daandii galaana Hormuz eeguuf yaaliin dippilomaasii taasifamaa jira.

title: Israeli gunfire wounds three Palestinians in Gaza's Khan Younis
english: Israeli military forces shot and injured three Palestinian civilians, including one woman, near the city of Khan Younis in Gaza. According to the local health ministry, this incident adds to the ongoing casualty count since the ceasefire began in late 2025. Thousands of people have been killed or wounded in the region throughout this period of continued violence.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በጋዛ ካን ዩኒስ አቅራቢያ በከፈቱት ተኩስ አንዲት ሴትን ጨምሮ ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። የጋዛ ጤና ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው፣ እ.ኤ.አ ከጥቅምት 2025 የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ በክልሉ የሟቾች እና የተጎጂዎች ቁጥር እየጨመረ ነው። በዚሁ ግጭት ምክንያት በርካታ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል እንዲሁም ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el ganda Kaani Yuunis kan Gaazaatti argamuutti dhukaasa bananiin dubartii tokko dabalatee namoonni sadii miidhamaniiru. Ministirri fayyaa Gaazaa akka ibsetti, erga ji'a Onkololeessa bara 2025 dhaabbiin waraanaa labsamee as namoonni kumaan lakkaa'aman ajjeefamanii akkasumas hedduun isaanii miidhamaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsa kana keessatti namoonni baay'een lubbuun isaanii darbuun ni yaadatama.

title: Hundreds camp on sweltering Rome street amid tussle over squatted building
english: Around 300 people, including many children, are protesting on the streets of Rome after being evicted from their long-term home, the Spin Time building, following a minor fire. Authorities closed the building, claiming it is unsafe, despite residents maintaining the damage was minimal and the eviction was politically motivated. The displaced families are now struggling through a severe heatwave while living in makeshift camps with the support of local volunteers.
amharic: በሮም ከተማ የቆየ የእሳት አደጋ መነሻን ተከትሎ ከኖሩበት የስፒን ታይም ሕንፃ የተፈናቀሉ ወደ 300 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች፣ ህፃናትን ጨምሮ በመንገድ ላይ ተቃውሞ እያሰሙ ነው። ባለስልጣናት ሕንፃው ለአገልግሎት የማይመች መሆኑን በመግለጽ የዘጋጉት ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎቹ ግን ጉዳቱ ቀላል መሆኑን እና እርምጃው የፖለቲካ ዓላማ እንዳለው ይናገራሉ። የተፈናቀሉ ቤተሰቦች በአሁኑ ወቅት በአካባቢው በሚገኝ ከፍተኛ ሙቀት እየተፈተኑ ሲሆን፣ በጎ ፈቃደኞች በሚያደርጉላቸው ድጋፍ በጊዜያዊ መጠለያ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magalaa Roomaa keessatti namoonni 300 ta'an kanneen ijoollee dabalatu, mana isaan waggoota dheeraaf keessa jiraachaa turan kan 'Spin Time' jedhamu irraa erga ari'amanii booda daandii irra qubataniru. Namoonni kunneen ari'amuun kan danda'ame ibidda xiqqoo ka'e hordofee yoo ta'u, mootummaan bakichi fayyaalummaa isaa waan dhabeef cufamuu qaba jedheera. Jiraattoonni garuu miidhaan ibiddaan ga'e xiqqoo ta'uu fi ari'amuun isaanii kun sababa siyaasaatiin ta'uu himatu. Maatiin kunneen amma hoo'a cimaa gannaa keessa kan jiran yoo ta'u, gargaarsa namoota fedhii isaaniitiin dhaabbatan argachuun bakka buufata yeroo keessa jiraachaa jiru.

title: Bangladesh say Shakib will not play cricket again after Hasina event
english: Bangladesh authorities have officially blocked star cricketer Shakib Al Hasan from representing the national team again after he participated in a public event with ousted former leader Sheikh Hasina. Shakib is currently facing murder investigations linked to the violent government crackdown on protesters that ended Hasina’s rule. Although the athlete expressed a desire to return home to face trial and continue his career, officials stated that his support for the convicted former prime minister has permanently ended his chances of playing for the country.
amharic: የባንግላዲሽ መንግስት ታዋቂው የክሪኬት ተጫዋች ሻኪብ አል ሃሰን ከስልጣን ከተወገደችው የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሃሲና ጋር በጋራ መታየቱን ተከትሎ ወደ ብሄራዊ ቡድኑ እንደማይመለስ አስታውቋል። ሻኪብ በሀገሪቱ ተቃውሞ ወቅት በተፈጠረው ግድያ ምርመራ እየተደረገበት ሲሆን፣ ወደ ሀገሩ ተመልሶ ክስ ለመጋፈጥ ፍላጎት እንዳለው ቢገልጽም መንግስት ግን ይህ ድርጊቱ ለሀገራዊ ቡድኑ መጫወት እንደማይችል ወስኗል። መንግስት እንደሚለው የቀድሞዋን መሪ በመደገፍ ያደረገው ንግግር ተጫዋቹ ወደ ስፖርቱ አለም እንዳይመለስ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Baangilaadhesh taphataa kirikeetii beekamaa Shaakib Al Haasan, pirezidaantii duraanii aangoorraa bu'an Sheikh Haasiinaa wajjin haala walqabateen gara garee biyyoolessaatti akka hin deebine murteesseera. Shaakib yeroo ammaa ajjeechaa mormitootaa irratti raawwatamee ture irratti shakkamee qorannoorra kan jiru yoo ta'u, innis gara biyyaatti deebi'ee seeraaf dhiyaachuuf qophii ta'uu ibseera. Haa ta'u malee, mootummaan inni namticha yakka raawwate jedhamee himatame kana gargaaruun isaa carraa isaa kan kuta ta'uu fi gara fuulduraatti biyyaaf taphachuu akka hin dandeenye beeksiseera.

title: Violence is driving Palestinian Christians out of their Holy Land
english: Palestinian Christians are experiencing increased violence and forced displacement throughout Jerusalem, the West Bank, and Gaza. Constant attacks on their communities and religious sites are threatening their presence in the region. As a result, the number of Christians living in their ancestral Holy Land is steadily declining.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ክርስቲያኖች በኢየሩሳሌም፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ እና በጋዛ ከፍተኛ ጥቃትና መፈናቀል እየደረሰባቸው ነው። በቤተክርስቲያናት እና በሃይማኖት አባቶች ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች በክልሉ የሚኖሩ ክርስቲያኖች ቁጥር እንዲቀንስ እያደረገ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት የክርስቲያን ማህበረሰብ በቅድስት ሀገራቸው የመቆየት እድላቸው እየተመናመነ ነው።
oromo: Kiristiyanoonni Falasxiin bulchiinsa Yerusaalem, gaanfa Lixaa fi Gaazaatti miidhaa fi buqqifamuu hamaa keessa jiru. Qulqulleessitoota amantii fi manneen amantii irratti haleellaan raawwatamuun jiraattota kiristiyana ta'an kan hir'ise yoo ta'u, kunis lakkofsi isaanii biyya isaanii keessatti akka hir'atu taasiseera.

title: FIFA’s Infantino backed in Colombia where he attends president inauguration
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino recently visited Colombia to attend the inauguration of President Abelardo de la Espriella. During the trip, he received public expressions of support from South American football leaders, even as he faces global criticism regarding his leadership and controversial policy proposals. Despite ongoing tensions with European football authorities, Infantino continues to focus on promoting unity in the sport as he prepares for his re-election bid next year.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በኮሎምቢያ የፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ደ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላን የመመረቂያ ስነ ስርዓት ላይ ለመገኘት በጉብኝት ላይ ናቸው። በዚሁ ጉብኝታቸው ወቅት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በስራ አመራራቸው ላይ ከፍተኛ ትችት ቢሰነዘርባቸውም፣ የደቡብ አሜሪካ የእግር ኳስ ማህበራት መሪዎች ድጋፋቸውን ገልጸውላቸዋል። በፊፋ ውስጥ የተፈጠረው አለመግባባት እና ከአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ አካላት ጋር ያለው ቅራኔ ቢኖርም፣ ኢንፋንቲኖ በቀጣዩ ዓመት ለሚደረገው ምርጫ ዝግጅታቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin FIFA Jaanii Infantiinoo ayyaana eebba pirezidaantii Kolombiyaa Abelaardoo de la Eespireeyalaa irratti argamuuf biyyattii daawwataniiru. Yeroo daawwannaa isaanii kana, hoogganoonni kubbaa miilaa Ameerikaa Kibbaa dhiibbaa fi qeeqa addunyaarraa isaan mudachaa jiru keessattuu tumsa isaanii isaanif ibsaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsa FIFA keessa jiruufi mormii qaamoolee Awurooppaa irraa isaan mudate osoo hin jiruun, Infantiinoon filannoo dhufu irratti dorgomuuf qophii isaanii itti fufaniiru.

title: Israeli shelling damages homes in Lebanese town
english: On Saturday morning, Israeli artillery fire struck areas near the town of al-Mansouri in southern Lebanon, causing damage to local homes. Despite ongoing diplomatic efforts to resolve the conflict, the Israeli military continues to occupy parts of the region and conduct regular attacks. Hezbollah remains excluded from these ceasefire negotiations.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ማለዳ ላይ የእስራኤል የጦር መሳሪያዎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው አል-ማንሱሪ ከተማ አቅራቢያ ጥቃት በመፈጸማቸው የነዋሪዎች መኖሪያ ቤቶች ተጎድተዋል። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ድርድር እየተካሄደ ቢሆንም፣ የእስራኤል ጦር በአካባቢው የሚገኙ ቦታዎችን መያዙን እና መደበኛ ጥቃቶችን መቀጠሉን ቀጥሏል። ሄዝቦላህ በእነዚህ የድርድር ሂደቶች ውስጥ አልተካተተም።
oromo: Ganama Sanbataa darbe, waraanni Israa'el naannoo magaalaa Al-Mansoorii kan kibba Libaanoositti argamu irratti dhukaasa banuun manni jireenyaa miidhamaniiru. Tattaaffiin dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamaa jiru iyyuu, waraanni Israa'el qe'ee naannichaa to'annaa isaa jala galchee haleellaa itti fufee jira. Gareen Heezbollaah marii nageenyaa kana keessatti hirmaannaa hin qabu.

title: Norway Football Federation calls for FIFA president to resign
english: The Norwegian Football Federation has officially demanded the resignation of FIFA president Gianni Infantino. They have also requested that FIFA’s ethics committee investigate several controversial decisions, including the handling of a player's suspension and the awarding of a peace prize to Donald Trump. This move highlights growing dissatisfaction within the federation regarding the current leadership's governance.
amharic: የኖርዌይ እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ከስልጣናቸው እንዲለቁ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ፌዴሬሽኑ በተጫዋች ቅጣት መቀልበስ እና ለዶናልድ ትራምፕ በተሰጠ የሰላም ሽልማት ዙሪያ ያሉ አወዛጋቢ ጉዳዮችን ለፊፋ የስነ-ምግባር ኮሚቴ አቤቱታ አቅርቧል። ይህ እርምጃ በፊፋ አመራር አሰጣጥ ላይ ያለው ቅሬታ እየጨመረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Federeeshiniin kubbaa miillaa Noorweey pirezidaantii FIFA Jaannii Infaantiinoo akka gadi lakkisan gaafateera. Dabalataanis, murtee nama mamsiisu kan akka maqfama taphataa fi badhaasa nageenyaa Doolaard Tiraampiif kenname ilaalchisee komitee safuu FIFA’tti himata dhiyeessaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun hoogganummaa FIFA irratti komiin cimaa dhufaa jiru agarsiisa.

title: Armenia puts Church leader on trial for allegedly being a Russian spy
english: The Armenian government has initiated legal proceedings against the head of the Apostolic Church and several other senior clergy members on charges of acting as Russian spies. These religious leaders face potential prison sentences of up to two years as tensions escalate between the church and Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan. Opponents of the government argue that these accusations are a strategic move to suppress political dissent.
amharic: የአርሜኒያ መንግስት የአገሪቱ የኦርቶዶክስ ቤተክርስቲያን መሪን እና ሌሎች ስድስት ከፍተኛ የቤተክርስቲያን አባላትን በሩሲያ ሰላይነት በመወንጀል ክስ መስርቷል። የቤተክርስቲያኑ አመራሮች ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኒኮል ፓሺንያን ጋር በተፈጠረው ውጥረት ምክንያት እስከ ሁለት ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ሊፈረድባቸው ይችላል። ይሁን እንጂ ተቺዎች ይህ ክስ መንግስትን የሚቃወሙ አካላትን ለማፈን የተደረገ ፖለቲካዊ እርምጃ እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Arminiyaa hogganaa Waldaa Kiristaanaa biyyattii fi qondaaltota amantii kan biroo ja'a irratti shakkii basaasummaa Raashiyaa ta'uun himata baneera. Hogganoonni amantii kun wal dhabdee Muummicha Ministeeraa Nikol Pashinyan waliin qaban irraa kan ka'e, hidhaa waggaa lamaa hanga ta'u isaan mudachuu danda'a. Namoonni himata kana morman, tarkiinni kun mormitoota siyaasaa callisiisuuf kan karoorfamee dhiibbaa siyaasaa akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: ‘I’ve never been counted’: DR Congo’s first census in 42 years
english: The Democratic Republic of Congo is launching its first national census in 42 years, following a long period of conflict and political instability since the last count in 1984. For millions of citizens, this process is crucial for obtaining official identification and gaining state recognition for the first time. The government intends to use the collected data to improve public service planning and address the needs of a rapidly growing population estimated at 112 million.
amharic: የዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ እ.ኤ.አ. ከ1984 በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ አገራዊ የህዝብ ቆጠራ ልታካሂድ ነው። ይህ ሂደት ከረጅም ጊዜ የእርስ በርስ ግጭትና የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት በኋላ ለሚኖሩ በሚሊዮን ለሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች ህጋዊ የማንነት መታወቂያ ለማግኘትና በመንግስት ዘንድ እውቅና ለማግኘት ትልቅ እድል ሆኖላቸዋል። መንግስትም የተሰበሰበውን መረጃ ለህዝብ አገልግሎት እና ለልማት እቅድ ለማዋል አቅዷል።
oromo: Demokiraatawaa Rippabilika Koongoo waggoota 42 keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf lakkoofsa ummataa gaggeessuuf qophiirra jirti. Hojiin kun uummata miliyoona 112 ta'uuf mirgaa fi eenyummaa isaanii mootummaa biratti beekamtii argachuuf kan gargaaru dha. Lakkoofsi kun kan gaggeeffamu waggoota dheeraaf biyyatti keessatti rakkoo nageenyaa fi jijjiirama siyaasaa erga mudatee booda yoo ta'u, mootummaanis ragaa kana tajaajila hawaasummaa fooyyessuuf akka itti fayyadamu ibseera.

title: PPS says family visit ban exposes Palestinian prisoners to further Israeli abuse
english: The Palestinian Prisoner's Society has condemned Israel's extension of a ban on family visits for detainees, warning it fosters an environment of isolation and abuse. They argue that this policy allows prison authorities to mistreat inmates without any external scrutiny or accountability. This decision follows a recent ruling by the Israeli Supreme Court that previously declared the restriction of Red Cross access to these prisoners to be illegal.
amharic: የፍልስጤም እስረኞች ማህበር እስራኤል በእስረኞች ላይ የቤተሰብ ጉብኝት መከልከሏን አጥብቆ አውግዟል። ድርጅቱ ይህ እርምጃ እስረኞችን ከአለም ሙሉ በሙሉ በማግለል ያለ ምንም ቁጥጥር የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን ለመፈጸም የሚያመች መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይህ የጉብኝት እገዳ የኢስራኤል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ቀደም ሲል ቀይ መስቀል እስረኞችን እንዳይጎበኝ መደረጉ ህገ-ወጥ ነው ብሎ የወሰነውን ውሳኔ የሚጻረር ነው።
oromo: Waldaan Hidhamtoota Falasxiin mootummaan Israa'el daawwii maatii hidhamtoota irratti kaa'e haaraa galchuun ishee balaaleffateera. Hojiin kun hidhamtoota addunyaa irraa addaan baasuun rakkoo fi miidhaa garaagaraa osoo hin sakatta'in akka irratti raawwatamu karaa bana jedhan. Murtiin kun kan darbe, mana murtii olaanaa Israa'el daawwii Komaitee Jijjiiramaa Isa Addunyaa (ICRC) dhorkuun seeraan alaa jedhee murteessuun isaa booda ta'uu isaa ibsameera.

title: Two civilians killed in Houthi strike on Marib as UN warns of large-scale conflict
english: Two civilians were killed and 14 others injured after Houthi forces launched missile and drone attacks on residential areas and displacement camps in Marib. The United Nations has expressed concern that the country is now facing a heightened risk of widespread conflict. In response to the assault, the Yemeni military conducted counter-operations against Houthi positions and vowed to retaliate firmly against further strikes.
amharic: በማሪብ ከተማ በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶችና ተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ የሮኬትና የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ንጹሃን ዜጎች ሲገደሉ ሌሎች 14 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በሀገሪቱ ላይ ሰፊ ግጭት የመቀስቀስ አደጋ እንደተጋረጠ አስጠንቅቋል። የየመን መንግስት ጦር ለጥቃቱ ምላሽ እንደሰጠ እና በቀጣይም መሰል ጥቃቶች ቢቀጥሉ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Houthiiwwan magaalaa Maariib keessatti iddoo jireenyaa fi bakka buqqaatonni qubataniitti dhukaasa rookeettii fi xiyyaara nama hin feene (drones) gaggeessaniin namoonni lama yoo du'an, 14 immoo madaa'aniiru. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii biyyattiin amma guddina waraana bal'aa hamaa ta'e keessa akka jirtu akeekkachiiseera. Mootummaan Yaman waraana isaa fayyadamuun deebii kan kenne yoo ta'u, weerarri kun itti fufuun isaa tarkaanfii cimaa akka hordofsiisu akeekkachiiseera.

title: 'End this war. NOW': US senators introduce resolution
english: A group of US senators has introduced a resolution demanding an immediate end to the conflict with Iran, labeling it as illegal. Senator John Hickenlooper highlighted the negative impact of the war, citing the loss of American lives, depleted military resources, and rising costs for essential goods like gas and fertilizer. The lawmakers are urging for an urgent cessation of military hostilities to prevent further damage.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴናተሮች ከኢራን ጋር እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ሕገ-ወጥ ነው በሚል በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆም የሚጠይቅ የውሳኔ ሃሳብ አቅርበዋል። ሴናተር ጆን ሂከንሉፐር ጦርነቱ የአሜሪካውያንን ህይወት እየቀጠፈ፣ ወታደራዊ ሀብቶችን እያሟጠጠ እና የነዳጅና ማዳበሪያ ዋጋን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየጨመረ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ህግ አውጪዎቹ ተጨማሪ ጉዳት እንዳይደርስ ጦርነቱ አሁን እንዲያበቃ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Senatoorri Ameerikaa waraanni Iran waliin geggeeffamaa jiru seeraan alaa ta'uu isaa ibsuun, akka ariitiin dhaabbatuuf murtoo tokko dhiyeessaniiru. Senatar Joon Hiikenluuper waraanni kun lubbuu lammiilee Ameerikaa galaafachuu, meeshaalee waraanaa xumuruu akkasumas gatii boba'aa fi xaa'oo dabaluu isaa ibsaniiru. Miseensonni kun miidhaan dabalataa akka hin geenyeef waraanni kun yeroodhuma kanatti akka dhaabbatu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Pezeshkian says Iran open to dialogue, warns against regional divisions
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has expressed his willingness to engage in diplomatic dialogue to protect national interests, while strictly maintaining the country's sovereignty and military strength. He emphasized the importance of fostering unity among neighboring Muslim nations to counter attempts by the US and Israel to create regional divisions. The president clarified that his government remains committed to peaceful relations but will not compromise on its defensive capabilities.
amharic: የኢራኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ መዘሽኪያን ሀገራቸው ብሔራዊ ጥቅሟን ለማስጠበቅ ለውይይት ዝግጁ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል፤ ሆኖም የሀገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነትና ወታደራዊ አቅም የሚነኩ ውሳኔዎችን እንደማይቀበሉ አስታውቀዋል። ከጎረቤት ሀገራት ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት ማሻሻል አስፈላጊ መሆኑን የጠቆሙት ፕሬዝዳንቱ፣ አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ለመፍጠር እየሞከሩ ያሉትን መከፋፈል እንደሚቃወሙ አስረድተዋል። ኢራን ከሙስሊም ሀገራት ጋር ወንድማማችነትን እንደምትመርጥና ለክልሉ ሰላም ቅድሚያ እንደምትሰጥም አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeshkiyaan, biyyi isaanii faayidaa biyyaa eeggachuuf marii gaggeessuuf fedhii akka qabu ibsanii, garuu kabaja biyyattii fi humna waraanaa irratti ajaja tokko illee akka hin fudhanne hubachiisaniiru. Pirezidaantichi, Ameerikaanii fi Israa'el naannichatti qoqqoodinsa uumuuf yaalii godhan goolabuuf, biyyoonni Musliimaa waliin ta'anii hojjechuu akka qaban gaafataniiru. Iraan hariiroo gaarii ollaa ishii wajjin uumuun akka barbaaddu ibsanii, garuu nageenya biyyaa fi humna ittisaa ishii irratti tasumaa marii hin taasiftu.

title: 300 Palestinian children killed in 300 days of Gaza ceasefire, Unicef says
english: UNICEF reports that 300 children have lost their lives in Gaza during the 300 days since a ceasefire was declared in October 2025. Despite the agreement, youth in the region continue to suffer from severe violence, malnutrition, disease, and poor sanitation. UNICEF officials emphasize that the ceasefire has failed to protect children and are calling for immediate, meaningful action to end their ongoing suffering.
amharic: የዩኒሴፍ መረጃ እንደሚያመለክተው ጥቅምት 2025 የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ከተደረገበት ጊዜ አንስቶ ባሉት 300 ቀናት ውስጥ በጋዛ 300 ሕጻናት ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ምንም እንኳን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢኖርም፣ በክልሉ የሚገኙ ሕጻናት በከፍተኛ የጤና ችግር፣ በረሃብ፣ በበሽታ እና የንጹህ ውሃ እጥረት እየተሰቃዩ ይገኛሉ። የዩኒሴፍ ኃላፊዎች ስምምነቱ ሕጻናትን ለመጠበቅ ባለመቻሉ፣ ተጨባጭ እርምጃዎች በአስቸኳይ እንዲወሰዱ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: UNICEF akka ibsetti, yeroo walii galteen dhaabbii waraanaa baatii Onkololeessa 2025 labsame kaasee guyyoota 300 keessatti daa'imman 300 ta'an Gaza keessatti lubbuun darbeera. Walii galtee kana jiraatus, daa'imman naannichaa hiyyummaa cimaa, dhukkubaa fi rakkoo bishaan qulqulluu dhabuun miidhamaa jiru. Hojjettoonni UNICEF walii galteen kun daa'imman hin eegne jechuun, rakkoo kana dhaabsisuuf tarkaanfiin ariifachiisaa akka fudhatamu gaafataniiru.

title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
english: A recent Russian missile strike near Kyiv resulted in the deaths of three people, including a young child, and injured several others. Falling debris caused fires and structural damage to local residential and business buildings. President Zelensky highlighted the urgent need for more air defense interceptors from allies, noting that current shortages are preventing Ukraine from effectively protecting civilians from these attacks.
amharic: በኪየቭ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የሩሲያ የሮኬት ጥቃት አንድ ህፃንን ጨምሮ ሶስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱ በርካታ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን እና ንብረቶችን በማውደም ሌሎች ሰዎች እንዲቆስሉ አድርጓል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ አጋር ሀገራት የአየር መከላከያ መሳሪያዎችን በአስቸኳይ እንዲያቀርቡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል፤ አሁን ያለው የመሳሪያ እጥረት ሀገሪቱ ዜጎቿን ከጥቃት እንዳትከላከል ማድረጉን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humni Raashiyaa magaalaa Kiyivitti raawwateen daa'ima tokko dabalatee namoonni sadii du'aniiru. Rokkeetiin kun mana jireenyaa fi qabeenya garaagaraa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuun namoonni biroo akka madaawan taasiseera. Preezidaant Zelenskiin, biyyoonni tumsitoonni meeshaalee qilleensa irraa ittisanii hatattamaan akka gumaachan gaafatanii, hanqinni meeshaalee kanaa biyyattiin lammiilee ishee haleellaa kana irraa akka hin ittifanne taasiseera jedhan.

title: 'I ran because I knew I would die': Russian drones target medics in Ukraine
english: Ukrainian medical workers are facing deliberate attacks from Russian drones while attempting to assist civilians in conflict zones. Reports indicate that these vehicles are being systematically hunted, even though medical facilities and ambulances are protected under international law. Statistics show a consistent and alarming rise in these strikes, leading Ukrainian officials to call for stronger international pressure to end this practice.
amharic: በዩክሬን የህክምና ባለሙያዎች በጦርነት ቀጠና ለተጎዱ ሰዎች እርዳታ በሚያደርጉበት ወቅት ሆን ተብሎ በሩሲያ ድሮኖች እየታደኑ ጥቃት እየደረሰባቸው ነው። ምንም እንኳን የህክምና ተቋማት እና አምቡላንሶች በዓለም አቀፍ ህግ የተጠበቁ ቢሆኑም፣ እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ስልታዊ በሆነ መልኩ እየተፈጸሙ መሆኑ ተገልጿል። በህክምና ተቋማት ላይ የሚደርሰው ጥቃት በየጊዜው እያደገ በመምጣቱ፣ የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት ይህንን አረመኔያዊ ድርጊት ለማስቆም ዓለም አቀፍ ጫና እንዲደረግ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ogeeyyoon fayyaa Yukreeniifi gargaartonni iddoo waraanaa keessatti namoota miidhaman gargaaruuf yeroo yaalan, xiyyara nama hin feene (drone) Ruusiyaan qajeelfamanii waraanan itti banamaa jira. Dhaabbileen fayyaafi konkolaatonni ambulance seera addunyaatiin eegumsa kan qaban ta'us, haleellaan kun haala sirna qabuun raawwatamaa jiraachuu gabaasni ni mul'isa. Haleellaan kun sadarkaa baay'ee yaaddessaa irra ga'aa waan jiruuf, mootummaan Yukreen gochi kun akka dhaabbatuuf dhiibbaa addunyaa akka godhamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Russian strikes near Ukrainian capital kill three, including child
english: A recent Russian missile attack in the Kyiv region resulted in three deaths, including a young child, and left several others injured. The assault caused significant damage and fires near the capital, highlighting Ukraine's ongoing struggle to defend against high-speed ballistic missiles with its limited air defense systems. Ukrainian officials emphasized that the country faces a critical shortage of interceptors, which is hampering their ability to protect civilians from an increasingly frequent Russian bombardment.
amharic: በኪየቭ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የሩሲያ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት አንድ ህፃናትን ጨምሮ ሶስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱ በዋና ከተማዋ አካባቢ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እና የእሳት አደጋ ያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ ዩክሬን ባላት ውስን የአየር መከላከያ ስርአት ፈጣን ሚሳኤሎችን ለመከላከል እየተቸገረች መሆኑን አሳይቷል። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት አገሪቱ ከባድ የመከላከያ መሳሪያዎች እጥረት እንዳለባት እና ይህ ደግሞ በሲቪሎች ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጥቃት ለመከላከል አስቸጋሪ እንዳደረገው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humni Ruusiyaa naannawaa Kiyeevitti miisaa’eliiin haleellaa gaggeesseen daa’ima tokko dabalatee namoonni sadii du’aniiru. Haleellaan kun magaala guddoo sana biratti miidhaa guddaa fi ibidda kan kaase yoo ta’u, Uukraayin meeshaalee ittisa qilleensaa gahaa hin qabneen miisaa’eloota saffisa guddaa qaban kana ittisuuf akka rakkachaa jirtu agarsiiseera. Abbootiin taayitaa Uukraayin akka jedhanitti, biyyattiin meeshaalee ittisa qilleensaa gahaa waan hin qabneef, haleellaa Ruusiyaa irraa lammiilee ishee eeguun daran ulfaataa ta’uu ibsaniiru.

title: Saudi intelligence chief meets Iraqi PM, renews Riyadh visit invitation
english: The Saudi intelligence chief visited Baghdad to meet with Iraq’s Prime Minister in an effort to repair diplomatic relations damaged by deadly joint US-Saudi airstrikes last month. During the meeting, the Saudi official formally invited the Prime Minister to visit Riyadh again after a previous trip was canceled in protest of the attacks. Both leaders discussed improving security coordination while the Iraqi government reaffirmed its commitment to preventing its territory from being used for regional conflicts.
amharic: የሳዑዲ የደህንነት መረጃ ሃላፊ ባለፈው ወር በተፈጸመው የአየር ጥቃት የተበላሸውን የሁለቱን ሀገራት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ለማደስ በባግዳድ ከኢራቅ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጋር ተወያይተዋል። የሳዑዲው ባለስልጣን ከዚህ ቀደም በአየር ጥቃቱ ምክንያት ተሰርዞ የነበረውን የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩን የሪያድ ጉብኝት ዳግም እንዲያደርጉ ግብዣ አቅርበዋል። የኢራቅ መሪም ሀገራቸው ለሌላ ሀገር ጥቃት መነሻ እንዳትሆን የገቡትን ቃል በማደስ በፀጥታ ጉዳዮች ላይ የሁለቱ ሀገራት ቅንጅት እንዲሻሻል ተወያይተዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan basaasaa Saudii ji'a darbe ajjeechaa fi miidhaa geessiseen booda hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii fooyyessuuf Bagdaaditti muummee ministira Iraaq waliin wal arganiiru. Qondaalli Saudii kun erga haleellaa sanaan walqabatee daawwannaan muummee ministirichaa erga haqamee booda, akka ammas Riyaad daawwatan afeerraa dhiyeessaniiru. Hoggantoonni lamaan kunneen qindoomina nageenyaa irratti mari'atan yoo ta'u, muummeen ministirichaa biyyi isaanii iddoo haleellaa biyya biraarra itti geggeeffamu akka hin taane mirkaneessaniiru.

title: US Senate passes Russia sanctions that could hurt India and China
english: The United States Senate has approved a significant package of sanctions against Russia, marking one of the most assertive actions taken during the Trump administration. These new measures include potential tariffs that could negatively impact countries like India and China, which are major importers of Russian goods. This legislative move signals an escalation in US economic pressure aimed at penalizing Russia.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴኔት በሩሲያ ላይ ጠንካራ ማዕቀቦችን የያዘ አዲስ ህግ አጽድቋል። ይህ እርምጃ በሩሲያ ላይ ከፍተኛ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና ለመፍጠር ያለመ ሲሆን፣ እንደ ሕንድ እና ቻይና ያሉ የሩሲያ ምርቶችን በብዛት የሚገዙ አገራት ላይ የጉምሩክ ቀረጥ በመጣል ሊጎዳ ይችላል። ይህ የሕግ አውጭው አካል ውሳኔ በሩሲያ ላይ የሚደረገውን የኢኮኖሚ ግፊት የሚያጠናክር ነው።
oromo: Mana maree seera baastuu Ameerikaa (US Senate) tarkaanfii cimaa fi seera sancii (sanctions) Raashiyaa irratti dabarsuuf qophiidha. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyoota akka Indiyaa fi Chaayinaa kanneen oomisha Raashiyaa hedduu bitatan irratti gibira dabalataa gaafachuu danda'a. Seerri kun dhiibbaa diinagdee Raashiyaa irratti qabu cimsuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Submerged Indonesian village re-emerges as drought lowers water levels
english: A village in Indonesia that was previously underwater has become visible again due to a significant drop in water levels caused by the dry season. Drone recordings show the remnants of buildings appearing in the Karian Reservoir. Authorities have confirmed that the facility is still operating safely despite the water level dropping by nearly a meter.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዥያ የካሪያን ግድብ ውስጥ በውሃ ተውጦ የነበረ መንደር በደረቅ ወቅቱ ምክንያት የውሃው መጠን በመቀነሱ ዳግም ብቅ ብሏል። በድሮን በተነሱ ምስሎች የመንደሩ ቅሪቶች በግልጽ ይታያሉ። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት የውሃው መጠን በ80 ሳንቲሜትር ቢቀንስም ግድቡ አሁንም ደህንነቱ በተጠበቀ ሁኔታ እየሰራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Indoneziyaatti, guddina bishaanii Kaariyaan jedhamu keessa kan ture gandii tokko, yeroo gogansaa kanatti sadarkaan bishaanii hirrachuu isaatiin darbee mul'achuu jalqabeera. Suuraawwan dirooniin kaafaman akka agarsiisanitti, manneen ganda sanaa bishaan keessaa ba'anii mul'atu. Itti gaafatamtoonni akka jedhanitti, sadarkaan bishaanii seentimeetira 80 kan hirrate ta'us, bu'uurichi ammas nagaa ta'ee hojjechaa jira.

title: US courts clear way for deportations of South Sudan, Myanmar nationals
english: US federal judges have ruled that the Trump administration may officially end Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for nationals from South Sudan and Myanmar. This decision removes deportation immunity and work authorization for thousands of individuals currently living in the country. Legal advocates expressed concern that these people now face removal to nations still suffering from severe instability and conflict.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌደራል ዳኞች የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከደቡብ ሱዳን እና ከማያንማር ለመጡ ዜጎች ይሰጥ የነበረውን ጊዜያዊ የጥበቃ ሁኔታ (TPS) ማቋረጥ እንደሚችል ወስነዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በአሜሪካ የሚኖሩ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች ከሀገር እንዳይባረሩ የሚያደርገውን ህጋዊ ከለላ እና የስራ ፈቃድ ያስወግዳል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾችም እነዚህ ሰዎች አሁንም ግጭት እና አለመረጋጋት ወደሚታይባቸው ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ መገደዳቸው አሳሳቢ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin seeraa federaalaa Ameerikaa mootummaan Traamp lammiilee Sudaan Kibbaa fi Miyaanmaar irratti eegumsa yeroo (TPS) jedhamu akka dhaabuuf heyyamaniiru. Murtuun kun namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman biyyattii keessa jiraatan irratti eegumsa arii'atamuu irraa ittisuu fi hayyama hojii irraa kaasa. Dhimma baqattootaa irratti kanneen falman, namoonni kun gara biyyoota waraana fi jeequmsaan guutamanitti deebifamuun isaanii yaaddoo guddaa akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: What could the Mecca defence pact mean for the US role in the Middle East?
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, a new pact stating that an attack on one nation will be considered an attack on all three. This move reflects a growing trend among regional powers to build independent security networks, driven by long-standing doubts about the reliability of United States support. While these countries are not trying to completely replace American influence, they are actively seeking to broaden their strategic options in light of the ongoing US-Israel conflict with Iran.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ የተፈራረሙት የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት በአንዱ አገር ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም አገራት ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ይቆጠራል ሲል ይደነግጋል። ይህ ስምምነት በአሜሪካ የጸጥታ ዋስትና ላይ እያደገ የመጣውን ጥርጣሬ ተከትሎ አገራቱ የራሳቸውን የጋራ መከላከያ አማራጮች ለመፍጠር እያደረጉት ያለውን ጥረት ያሳያል። አገራቱ የአሜሪካን ተጽዕኖ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለመተካት ባይሞክሩም፣ በእስራኤል እና ኢራን መካከል ያለው ጦርነት ባስከተለው አለመረጋጋት ምክንያት የየራሳቸውን ደህንነት ለማጠናከር እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkii fi Paakistaan walii galtee ittisa biyyaalessaa kan Mecca jedhamu kan mallatteessan yoo ta'u, kunis biyyoota sadan keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame akka isa sadaniinuutti ilaalamu ibsa. Tarkaanfiin kun shakkii biyyoonni naannichaa gargaarsa amansiisummaa Ameerikaa irratti qaban irraa kan maddeedha. Biyyoonni kun dhiibbaa Ameerikaa guutummaatti bakka buusuuf kan hin yaalle ta'us, waraana Ameerikaa fi Israa'el Itoophiyaa waliin godhamaa jiruun wal qabatee nageenya isaanii mirkaneeffachuuf mala biraa barbaachisaa jiru.

title: Trump shifts blame to Republicans for waning support from public
english: President Donald Trump is attributing his declining popularity to the actions and decisions of Republican lawmakers. These senators are currently distancing themselves from the President by avoiding controversial votes during their summer recess. Key political tensions fueling this divide include disagreements over potential conflict with Iran and public pressure to disclose information regarding the Epstein files.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የህዝብ ድጋፋቸው እየቀነሰ የመጣው በሪፐብሊካን የህግ አውጪዎች ድርጊት እና ውሳኔዎች ምክንያት እንደሆነ ይናገራሉ። እነዚህ የሴኔት አባላት በበጋው የእረፍት ጊዜያቸው አወዛጋቢ የሆኑ ድምጾችን ከመስጠት በመቆጠብ ከፕሬዝዳንቱ እየራቁ ይገኛሉ። ለዚህ ክፍፍል ምክንያት ከሆኑት ዋና ዋና ጉዳዮች መካከል ከኢራን ጋር ሊፈጠር የሚችለው ጦርነት እና የኤፕስታይን ፋይሎችን እንዲለቀቁ የሚቀርበው የህዝብ ጥያቄ ይጠቀሳሉ።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp deggersi isaanii ummata biratti hir'achaa kan jiru tarkaanfii fi murtoo miseensota paartii Ripaabilikaanii irraa kan ka'e ta'uu ibsaniiru. Miseensonni seeneetii kunneen guyyoota boqonnaa gannaa keessatti sagalee kennuu irraa of qusachuun pireezidaanticha irraa fagaachaa jiru. Walitti bu'iinsa kanaaf kan sababa ta'an dhimmoonni gurguddoon waraana biyya Iraan waliin uumamuu danda'uufi gabaasni 'Epstein' akka ifa bahu dhiibbaa uummata irraa dhufee dha.

title: Colombia’s new president takes office vowing to ‘crush’ narco-terrorism
english: Abelardo De La Espriella has officially become the president of Colombia following a tight electoral victory in June. He has committed his administration to aggressively fighting drug-related violence and terrorism. Additionally, the new leader plans to focus on economic growth and strengthening diplomatic ties with the United States.
amharic: አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላ በሰኔ ወር በተካሄደው ጠባብ የምርጫ ውጤት አሸናፊ በመሆን የኮሎምቢያ ፕሬዝዳንት ሆነው ተሹመዋል። አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት በአገሪቱ ያለውን የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውርና ሽብርተኝነት ለመዋጋት ቃል ገብተዋል። እንዲሁም የኢኮኖሚ ተግዳሮቶችን በመፍታት ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላቸውን የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር አቅደዋል።
oromo: Abelardo De La Espriella erga filannoo ji'a Waxabajjii mo'atee booda pirezidaantii Kolombiyaa ta'e muudameera. Innis nageenya biyyattii eeguuf jecha yakka gurgurtaa sammuu namaa hadoochan fi shororkeessummaa irratti duuluuf waadaa galeera. Kana malees, jijjiirama dinagdee fiduu fi hariiroo dippilomaasii Ameerikaa wajjin qaban cimsuuf karoorfateera.

title: De la Espriella sworn in as Colombia’s leader, vows armed group crackdown
english: Abelardo de la Espriella has been inaugurated as Colombia's new president, marking a significant shift toward right-wing leadership. The former lawyer has pledged to abandon peace negotiations with armed groups in favor of a militaristic crackdown to restore national stability. His administration also plans to revive the oil and gas sector while significantly reducing government spending.
amharic: አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላ የኮሎምቢያ አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ሆነው የተሾሙ ሲሆን ይህም በአገሪቱ የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ ፈጥሯል። የቀድሞው ጠበቃ ከታጠቁ ቡድኖች ጋር የሚደረገውን የሰላም ድርድር በማቆም፣ በአገሪቱ መረጋጋትን ለማስፈን ጥብቅ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ቃል ገብተዋል። አዲሱ አስተዳደር የነዳጅ እና ጋዝ ኢንዱስትሪን ለማነቃቃት እና የመንግስት ወጪን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ለመቀነስ እቅድ አለው።
oromo: Abelardo de la Espriella pirezidaantii haaraa Kolombiyaa ta'uun kakuu raawwateera; kunis jijjiirama siyaasaa gara mirgaatti godhame kan agarsiisuudha. Inni duraan abukaatoo ture kun, gareewwan hidhatan wajjin marii nagaa gochuu dhaabuudhaan, nageenya biyyattii kabachiisuuf tarkaanfii waraanaa cimaa fudhachuuf waadaa galeera. Mootummaan isaa damee boba'aa fi gaazii deebisee jajjabeessuufi baasii mootummaa hir'isuuf karoorfateera.

title: CNN: Top general says US needs ‘off ramp’ from Iran war
english: A senior US military leader has advised the Trump administration to seek a diplomatic solution to avoid further escalation with Iran. General Dan Caine expressed concerns that relying solely on airstrikes would be ineffective and potentially counterproductive. He has held discussions with key administration officials regarding alternative strategies to de-escalate the ongoing tensions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ መኮንን የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከኢራን ጋር ያለውን ግጭት ለመቀነስ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄ እንዲፈልግ መክረዋል። ጄኔራል ዳን ኬን በአየር ጥቃት ብቻ መተማመን ውጤታማ አለመሆኑን እና ሁኔታውን የበለጠ እንደሚያባብሰው ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ጉዳዩን በተመለከተ ከዋና ዋና የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ጋር አማራጭ የመፍትሄ መንገዶችን ተወያይተዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraanaa olaantuun Ameerikaa tokko mootummaan Trump walitti buiinsa Iran waliin jiru tasgabbeessuuf karaa diippilomaasii akka barbaadu gorsaniiru. Jeneraal Daan Keeniin, haleellaa qilleensa qofaan irratti hunda’uun bu’aa hin qabu akkasumas rakkoo caalu fiduu danda’a jechuun yaaddoo ibsaniiru. Dhimma kana ilaalchisee gaggeessitoota mootummaa kanneen biroo waliin karaa biroo ittiin waldhabdee kana furuun danda’amu irratti mari’ataniiru.

title: Turkish, Pakistani and Saudi flags shine in Kingdom's cities
english: Saudi Arabia recently illuminated major city landmarks with the flags of Turkey, Pakistan, and itself to celebrate the signing of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement. This new pact highlights a collaborative effort between the three nations to boost regional security and maintain global stability. By entering this partnership, the countries aim to foster a safer and more prosperous future for everyone.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ የመካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነትን መፈረሟን ተከትሎ የቱርክን፣ የፓኪስታንን እና የራሷን ባንዲራዎች በዋና ዋና የከተማዋ ሕንፃዎች ላይ አሳይታለች። ይህ ስምምነት በሶስቱ አገራት መካከል የክልሉን ደህንነት ለማጠናከር እና ዓለም አቀፍ ሰላምን ለመጠበቅ ያለውን የጋራ ቁርጠኝነት የሚያሳይ ነው። አገራቱ በዚህ አጋርነት አማካኝነት ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ እና የተሻለ ብልጽግና ያለው የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ለመፍጠር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan waliigaltee ittisa gamtaa Makkaa mallatteessuu ishee hordofee, alaandawwan biyyoota Turkii, Paakistaanii fi kan ishee magaalonni gurguddoon itti ifanii jiru. Waliigalteen kun nageenya naannichaa cimsuu fi tasgabbii guutuu addunyaa mirkaneessuuf biyyoonni sadan waliin hojjechuuf fedhii qaban kan mul'isu dha. Gamtaan kun gara fuulduraatti jireenya tasgabbii qabuu fi badhaadhaa ta'e uumuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Muslim nations, organisations welcome Saudi Arabia-Turkey-Pakistan defence pact
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have officially entered into a new trilateral defense agreement to strengthen regional security and cooperation. Various Muslim-majority nations and international organizations have praised the pact as a vital step toward ensuring long-term stability in the area. Supporters believe this strategic partnership will foster solidarity and help address the growing security challenges currently facing the Islamic world.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን የክልሉን ደህንነት እና ትብብር ለማጠናከር የሚያስችል አዲስ የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። የተለያዩ የእስልምና ሀገራት እና ዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት ይህ ስምምነት በክልሉ ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመፍጠር ትልቅ ሚና ይኖረዋል ሲሉ አወድሰውታል። የዚህ ስምምነት ደጋፊዎች የዚህ ስትራቴጂካዊ አጋርነት መፈጠር በኢስላማዊው ዓለም ውስጥ ያለውን አንድነት በማጠናከር አሁን የተጋረጡ የደህንነት ስጋቶችን ለመቅረፍ እንደሚረዳ ያምናሉ።
oromo: Turkiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan nageenyaa fi walta'iinsa naannichaa cimsuuf waliigaltee ittisaa haaraa waliin mallatteessaniiru. Biyyoonni Islaamaa fi dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa garaagaraa waliigaltee kana naannichatti tasgabbii fiduuf tarkaanfii barbaachisaa ta'e jechuun galateeffataniiru. Deggertoonni walta'iinsi kun tokkummaa biyyoota Islaamaa cimsuu fi rakkoolee nageenyaa yeroo ammaa mudachaa jiran furuuf gumaacha guddaa qaba jedhanii amanu.

title: Oman 'facing environmental disaster' as tanker leaks off its coast
english: An old oil tanker, believed to be part of Russia's shadow fleet, is leaking a massive oil slick near a protected marine area off the coast of Oman. The vessel has been stranded for several weeks following unexplained explosions, and the spread of oil has reached hundreds of square kilometers. Environmental organizations are warning that this incident could cause a long-lasting ecological disaster in the region.
amharic: የሩሲያ የጥላ መርከቦች ቡድን አካል ነው የተባለ የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የነዳጅ መፍሰስ እያደረሰ ይገኛል። መርከቧ ያልታወቀ ፍንዳታ ካጋጠማት በኋላ ላለፉት ጥቂት ሳምንታት ተጣብቃ የቆየች ሲሆን፣ የፈሰሰው ነዳጅ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ካሬ ኪሎ ሜትሮችን እንዲሸፍን አድርጓል። የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ተቋማት ይህ አደጋ በአካባቢው ላይ ከፍተኛ እና የረጅም ጊዜ ስነ-ምህዳራዊ ጉዳት ሊያስከትል እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Markabni boba'aa kan 'shadow fleet' Ruusiyaa ta'e jedhamee shakkamu tokko, qarqara galaana Omaanitti boba'aa dhangalaasuun balaa naannoo mudachuu akka danda'u ibsameera. Markabni kun erga dhohiinsa ifa hin taaneen miidhamee torbanoota hedduuf achumaan dhaabatee kan ture yoo ta'u, dhangala'aan boba'ichaa lafa bal'ina isaa kiilomeetira iskuweerii dhibbaan lakka'amu haguugeera. Dhaabbileen naannoo eegan akka jedhanitti, balaan kun miidhaa ekoloojii cimaa fi yeroo dheeraa turuu danda'u qaqqabsiisuu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Sudan’s war threatens an ‘entire generation’s’ future, UN warns
english: The ongoing civil war in Sudan has severely crippled the country's education system, leaving over eight million children without access to schooling. United Nations officials warn that the destruction of most schools and the constant threat of violence are robbing an entire generation of their future. Despite efforts to provide alternative learning, the situation remains dire as children face displacement, instability, and a lack of resources.
amharic: በሱዳን እየተካሄደ ያለው የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት የሀገሪቱን የትምህርት ሥርዓት በእጅጉ በመጉዳቱ ከስምንት ሚሊዮን በላይ ህጻናት ከትምህርት ገበታ ውጪ ሆነዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንደገለጸው፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ትምህርት ቤቶች በመውደማቸው እና በጦርነቱ ምክንያት አንድ ሙሉ ትውልድ የወደፊት ተስፋውን እያጣ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ህጻናትን ወደ ትምህርት ለመመለስ ጥረቶች ቢደረጉም፣ የህጻናቱ መፈናቀል እና የጸጥታ ችግሮች ሁኔታውን ይበልጥ አስቸጋሪ አድርገውታል።

Hojjettoonni gargaarsaa ijoollee barnootatti deebisuuf yaalii gochaa jiranis, buqqa'uu fi nageenya dhabuun rakkoo kana daran ulfaataa taasiseera.

title: Puerto Rico rations water as severe drought leaves reservoirs depleted
english: Puerto Rico has initiated water rationing for approximately 180,000 homes due to an intense drought that has significantly lowered reservoir levels. Residents in the affected areas are currently depending on water tankers and emergency storage tanks to meet their daily needs. The authorities implemented these strict measures as dry weather conditions continue to persist across the island.
amharic: በፖርቶ ሪኮ በተከሰተው ከፍተኛ ድርቅ የውሃ ማጠራቀሚያዎች በመድረቃቸው ከ180,000 በላይ ለሚሆኑ አባወራዎች የውሃ አጠቃቀም ተወስኗል። በችግሩ የተጎዱ ነዋሪዎች የዕለት ተዕለት ፍላጎታቸውን ለማሟላት በውሃ መኪኖች እና በጊዜያዊ የውሃ ማጠራቀሚያዎች ላይ ጥገኛ ሆነዋል። ደረቅ የአየር ሁኔታው እየቀጠለ በመምጣቱ ባለሥልጣናቱ እነዚህን ጥብቅ እርምጃዎች ለመውሰድ ተገደዋል።
oromo: Puerto Rico keessatti roobni roobuu dhabuun isaa fi hongeen cimaan mudate qulqullina bishaan manca’ee bishaan hir’achuun isaa mana 180,000 ol ta’aniif bishaan hirunni akka gaggeeffamu dirqisiiseera. Jiraattonni naannoo sanaa barbaachisummaa bishaan guyyuu isaanii guuttachuuf konkolaattota bishaan baatan fi kuusaa bishaanitti fayyadamaa jiru. Haalli qilleensa gogsoon itti fufuu isaa hordofee, qaamoleen mootummaa tarkaanfiiwwan cimaa kana fudhachuuf dirqamaniiru.

title: US Senate passes sweeping Russian energy sanctions bill amid Ukraine war
english: The U.S. Senate has approved a significant sanctions bill aimed at crippling Russia's energy revenue during its ongoing war in Ukraine. The legislation imposes 100 percent tariffs on Russian oil and gas imports and targets illicit shipping networks used to bypass existing trade restrictions. This bipartisan measure, which now awaits a vote in the House of Representatives, is intended to cut off funding for the Russian military and pressure Moscow to engage in peace negotiations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴኔት በዩክሬን ላይ እያደረሰ ያለውን ወረራ ለመግታት በሩሲያ የኢነርጂ ዘርፍ ላይ ጠንካራ ማዕቀቦችን መጽደቁን ተከትሎ አዲስ ህግ አውጥቷል። ህጉ በሩሲያ ነዳጅ እና ጋዝ ላይ መቶ በመቶ ታሪፍ የሚጥል ሲሆን፣ ማዕቀቡን በሕገ-ወጥ መንገድ የሚያልፉ የባህር ትራንስፖርት መረቦችንም ያነጣጠረ ነው። ይህ በሁለቱም የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ድጋፍ ያገኘው ውሳኔ የሩሲያን የጦር መሣሪያ የገንዘብ ምንጭ በማድረቅ ወደ ድርድር ጠረጴዛ እንድትመጣ ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው።

title: Iran war live: Trilateral Mecca defence pact signed, as Hormuz deal looms
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have established a new mutual defense agreement in Mecca, treating an attack on one as an act of aggression against all three. Meanwhile, Iran and Oman are discussing a framework to manage activity in the Strait of Hormuz, pending final approval from higher authorities. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated that while his country opposes regional conflict, it remains committed to resisting external pressure.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ ከተማ አዲስ የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ስምምነቱ በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ ይቆጠራል ይላል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር አጠቃቀም ላይ እየተወያዩ ሲሆን፣ ኢራን ጦርነት እንደማትፈልግ ነገር ግን ግፊትን እንደማትቀበል አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Saudi Arabiyaan, Turkiifi Paakistaan magaala Makkaatti waliigaltee ittisaa waliinii kan mallatteessan yoo ta'u, isaaniin keessaa tokko irratti miidhaan yoo ga'e akka guutuu isaaniitti fudhatama jedhaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Iraaniifi Omaan qajeelfama daandii bishaan Hormuz to'atu irratti mari'achaa jiru. Prezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeskiyaan biyyi isaanii waraana akka hin barbaanne garuu dhiibbaa irra gahu kamiyyuu akka hin fudhanne ibsaniiru.

title: Donald Trump renews effort to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook
english: President Donald Trump has renewed his attempt to remove Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook by threatening her with unsubstantiated mortgage fraud allegations. The administration claims she acted with negligence, though critics view this as a politically motivated move to gain control over interest rate decisions. This unprecedented action challenges the long-standing independence of the US central bank, which is legally designed to operate free from executive interference.

title: Arab League secretary-general condemns Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia
english: The head of the Arab League has officially denounced a recent Houthi missile or drone strike against Saudi Arabia's Najran region. This offensive resulted in injuries to a number of innocent civilians in the area. The organization expressed its strong support for Saudi Arabia and warned that these hostile actions are endangering regional stability.

Gamtaan sun Saudii Arabiyaa waliin akka dhaabbatu ibsuun, haleellaan kun tasgabbii naannichaa miidha jiraachuu akeekkachiiseera.

title: Lebanon's Health Ministry says Israeli attacks have killed 4,335 people since 2 March
english: The Lebanese Health Ministry reports that over 4,300 people have been killed and more than 12,000 injured by Israeli military strikes since early March. While Israeli forces remain in parts of southern Lebanon, diplomatic efforts are underway to facilitate a ceasefire and oversee the disarmament of Hezbollah. Officials are currently finalizing a list of international partners to help monitor the situation under a proposed US-led agreement.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ጤና ጥበቃ ሚኒስቴር ከማርች ወር መጀመሪያ አንስቶ በእስራኤል በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ከ4,300 በላይ ሰዎች መሞታቸውን እና ከ12,000 በላይ መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቋል። የእስራኤል ጦር በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የተወሰኑ አካባቢዎችን ተቆጣጥሮ ቢቆይም፣ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች እየተደረጉ ነው። በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የሂዝቦላህን ትጥቅ መፍታት የሚከታተሉ ዓለም አቀፍ ቡድኖችን ለመምረጥ ስምምነት ላይ እየተደረሰ ይገኛል።

Waraanni Israa'el kutaa Kibba Libaanos to'achuu isaa itti fufus, mariin nagaa fi waldhabdee dhaabuuf xiyyeeffannoon kennameef jira. Mootummoonni lamaan gareen Hizbollaa meeshaa hiikkachuu isaa hordofuu kan danda'an biyyoota filachuuf walii galtee irra ga'aa jiru.

title: Will Pakistan-Saudi-Turkiye alliance actually create a new regional order?
english: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have established a new mutual defense agreement known as the Mecca Joint Defence Pact. This alliance aims to address regional security concerns as these nations navigate the ongoing tensions between Iran and Israel. While the agreement signifies a united front, experts remain uncertain about the actual military commitment each nation will provide if one is attacked.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ የተፈረመ 'የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት' የተሰኘ አዲስ የትብብር ስምምነት አድርገዋል። ይህ ጥምረት በኢራን እና በእስራኤል መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የክልሉን የፀጥታ ስጋት ለመጋፈጥ ያለመ ነው። ስምምነቱ የአጋሮቹን አንድነት የሚያሳይ ቢሆንም፣ ከሦስቱ አገራት አንዱ ጥቃት ቢደርስበት ሌሎቹ አገራት ምን ያህል ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ እንደሚያደርጉ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም።
oromo: Turkiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaafi Paakistaan walii-galtee ittisa biyyaalessaa kan 'Mecca Joint Defence Pact' jedhamu mallatteessaniiru.
